normative_terms.sha256: FIPS 180-4 SHA-256; binary records contain the 32 digest bytes in standard output order and JSON receipts contain lowercase hexadecimal.
normative_terms.little_endian: Unsigned integers are serialized least-significant byte first at their declared width.
normative_terms.float_bits: Finite IEEE-754 binary16 or binary32 values are bit-cast to uint16 or uint32 and serialized little-endian; NaN and infinity abort before a record is published.
normative_terms.logical_bytes: Only named initialized semantic elements are hashed; pointers, addresses, allocator padding, mapping slack, filenames, inodes, page residency, and uninitialized storage are forbidden preimage bytes.
normative_terms.ascii_name: One to 255 bytes matching [A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]+ with no NUL, encoded exactly as ASCII.

fields_in_order: offset 0: 8 bytes ASCII GMIDOB1 followed by one NUL byte
offset 32: 32 raw bytes of the complete v5 candidate source-tree SHA-256
offset 64: 32 raw bytes of this ABI artifact SHA-256
offset 96: 32 raw bytes of the exact raw-population SHA-256
offset 128: 32 raw bytes of the exact reversible modeled-stream SHA-256
common_header.open_rule: Create each stream with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC beneath a pre-opened absolute output-directory descriptor; any open, write, seek, flush, fsync, close, or geometry error aborts the arm.
common_header.identity_rule: All four streams for one run have byte-identical common fields except stream_kind. Encoder and decoder differ only in direction and direction-specific records.

fields_in_order: 32 raw bytes SHA-256 over every byte after the 160-byte header and before this footer
common_footer.clean_eof_rule: The footer is written only after complete successful observation, fsynced, and followed immediately by EOF. Missing, duplicate, partial, trailing, or count-inconsistent footers reject the stream. The body digest starts after the 160-byte common header.

layout.record_framing: tag[4], uint32 record_bytes including framing, uint8 partition, uint8 dtype, uint8 rank, uint8 flags=0, uint32 tensor_ordinal, uint64 logical_bytes, uint32 leaf_bytes=4096, uint16 name_bytes, uint16 reserved=0, rank uint64 dimensions, then name_bytes ASCII name bytes
layout.ordering: Partition-code ascending, then one source-frozen tensor_ordinal sequence beginning at zero within each partition; ordinals and names are unique and contiguous.
layout.struct_rule: C++ structs, bitfields, bools, enums, pointers, and padded rows must be exposed as separately typed logical tensors rather than hashed through object memory.

probability.record: One final uint16 probability in little-endian order after all heads and immediately before the arithmetic range split.
probability.count_rule: Exactly one record per coded bit; coded_bits equals modeled_events multiplied by 8 for the frozen byte-LSTM population.
probability.direction_rule: Encoder and decoder use the same hook and must emit byte-identical bodies for a synchronized arm and replicate.

checkpoint.record_framing: Exactly 332 bytes: tag[4], uint32 record_bytes=332, uint8 checkpoint_kind, uint8 hook_phase, uint16 reserved=0, uint32 range_low, uint32 range_high, uint32 range_code, uint32 coder_aux, uint64 modeled_events, uint64 coded_bits, uint64 probability_records, uint64 payload_prefix_bytes, uint64 dirty_leaf_events, uint64 midpoint_update_records, probability_sha256[32], payload_prefix_sha256[32], then six partition_root_sha256[32] in partition-code order

hook_phases.0: After model construction and retained pretraining, layout publication, and initial full state-root build; immediately before the first modeled BeginTraceByte.
hook_phases.1: Immediately after EndTraceByte for every completed modeled-event coordinate divisible by 64, after all predictor effects of that event and after any midpoint clear, before the next BeginTraceByte.
hook_phases.2: Immediately after the final EndTraceByte and before Encoder::Flush or decoder finalization; emitted even when a periodic row has the same coordinate.
hook_phases.3: Immediately after Encoder::Flush or successful decoder stream finalization; state roots must equal terminal_pre_flush roots while final payload-prefix evidence includes every payload byte.

checkpoint.count_formula: floor(modeled_events / 64) + 3: one start, every periodic coordinate, one terminal_pre_flush, and one finalization row.
checkpoint.coder_fields: Encoder sets range_code=0 and records its exact low/high plus declared coder_aux; decoder records low/high/code plus declared coder_aux. No encoder/decoder coder-state equality is inferred.
checkpoint.rolling_digest_rule: probability_sha256 is a clone-finalized digest over all preceding probability records without resetting the live hash.
checkpoint.payload_prefix_rule: payload_prefix_sha256 hashes exactly the first payload_prefix_bytes in payload-file order. Encoder hashes logically emitted bytes including its in-memory output buffer; decoder hashes physically consumed payload bytes. Equality is compared only between matched arms in the same direction and at the same coordinate.
checkpoint.state_rule: Each partition root is the current canonical Merkle-forest state after all dirty leaves for the checkpoint are refreshed.

update.record_framing: Exactly 328 bytes: tag[4], uint32 record_bytes=328, uint64 update_ordinal, uint64 segment_start_event, uint32 native_start_phase, uint32 closure_phase, uint8 arm, uint8 committed, uint8 detached, uint8 target_rotation, uint32 reserved=0, then nine SHA-256 fields in this order: closure_target, captured_inputs, output_error_adjoint, recurrent_gradient_and_adam, output_gradient, pre_restore_dynamic, post_replay_dynamic, detached_before_clear, scratch_after_clear
update.arm_rule: P emits no rows. K emits the formula count with committed=0, detached=1, target_rotation=0. F emits the formula count with committed=1, detached=0, target_rotation=0. S emits the formula count with committed=1, detached=0, target_rotation=16.
update.timing: All nine digests are computed inline while their complete preimages exist. The row is emitted only after scratch clear and post-replay state are available, using locally retained digests rather than rereading cleared storage.
update.aggregate_rule: Each aggregate follows update_aggregate_contract below; tensor groups and order are declared by the content-addressed v5 source layout manifest and independently checked against source members.
update.synchronization_rule: For K, F, and S, matched encoder and decoder update bodies are byte-identical.

update_aggregate_contract.preimage: domain, aggregate_code uint8, three reserved zero bytes, tensor_count uint32LE, then for each tensor in source-frozen group order: metadata_digest[32], logical_bytes uint64LE, content_sha256[32]. Each content digest hashes the exact canonical tensor bytes at the named observation point.
update_aggregate_contract.empty_aggregate: When a group is inapplicable, tensor_count is zero and no tensor rows follow; the digest is still computed from the domain, aggregate_code, three zero bytes, and uint32LE zero.

group_population.closure_target: The 32 source-order midpoint_targets_ uint32 values before S association rotation; target_rotation in the record is the only F/S association difference.
group_population.captured_inputs: Source-order midpoint symbols, auxiliary inputs, output probabilities, hidden features, pending rows, and every layer local-32 captured history, gate state, gate normalization, inverse variance, start state, and closure state needed by backward or replay.
group_population.output_error_adjoint: Complete source-order midpoint output-error and output-adjoint logical tensors after construction and before recurrent backward mutates shared scratch.
group_population.recurrent_gradient_and_adam: Every complete recurrent dense/symbol/gamma/beta gradient plus the corresponding post-update master, first moment, second moment, shadow, and update-step value. K hashes hypothetical detached values; F/S hash committed live values.
group_population.output_gradient: The complete output gradient plus every affected post-update output master and compile-selected shadow. K hashes hypothetical detached rows; F/S hash committed live rows.
group_population.pre_restore_dynamic: The closure hidden vector and every layer closure cell-state vector captured immediately before restoring segment-start state.
group_population.post_replay_dynamic: The live hidden vector and every layer live cell-state vector immediately after state-only replay and before scratch clear.
group_population.detached_before_clear: K hashes every detached recurrent/output master, moment, and shadow logical value after its hypothetical update. P/F/S use the canonical empty aggregate.
group_population.scratch_after_clear: Every midpoint-partition tensor and scalar after MidpointClearScratch, including zeroed sinks, flags, counters, vectors, and buffers at their declared logical lengths. Persistent modeled-event and arm identity fields are excluded and remain separately recorded.

state_root_contract.metadata_digest: SHA-256(metadata domain, partition uint8, dtype uint8, rank uint8, flags uint8=0, tensor_ordinal uint32LE, logical_bytes uint64LE, leaf_bytes uint32LE, name_bytes uint16LE, reserved uint16LE=0, dimensions uint64LE in order, ASCII name).
state_root_contract.leaf_digest: SHA-256(leaf domain, metadata_digest, leaf_index uint64LE, leaf_length uint32LE, exact canonical logical bytes). The final leaf uses its actual positive length; zero-length tensors are forbidden.
state_root_contract.node_digest: At level zero, pair adjacent leaves. A pair is SHA-256(node domain, metadata_digest, level uint32LE, node_index uint64LE, left_digest, right_digest). When a level has an unpaired final child, its parent is SHA-256(lone-node domain, metadata_digest, level uint32LE, node_index uint64LE, child_digest). Repeat over each resulting level until one root remains; no padding leaves exist.
state_root_contract.tensor_root: SHA-256(tensor domain, metadata_digest, logical_leaf_count uint64LE, tree_root).
state_root_contract.partition_root: SHA-256(partition domain, partition_code uint8, three reserved zero bytes, tensor_count uint32LE, ordered tensor roots).
state_root_contract.update_algorithm: Build every leaf at start using bounded reads. Every semantic write marks all intersecting logical leaves dirty after the write. At a checkpoint, recompute dirty leaves in tensor/leaf order, update only affected ancestors, then derive tensor and partition roots.
state_root_contract.terminal_control: After the last modeled event, independently reread every logical tensor in bounded chunks and rebuild all six forests from zero. Incremental and full terminal roots must match before finalization publication.
state_root_contract.write_completeness: A source audit must map every named future-affecting state object and every write site to exactly one typed tensor and dirty-range hook. Missing, overlapping, aliased without declaration, unordered, or unreachable mappings reject implementation closure.
state_root_contract.mutation_controls: For every partition, a source-bound harness flips one canonical byte in one copied leaf. Exactly that tensor and partition root must change; all other partition roots must remain equal. Restoring the byte must restore the original roots.

partition_population.dynamic: Byte-LSTM hidden_ and every LstmLayer running cell state.
partition_population.parameters: Recurrent dense/symbol/gamma/beta masters, output masters, and compile-selected fp16 shadows.
partition_population.optimizer: All recurrent first/second moments and update_steps_ counters.
partition_population.ordinary_tape: layer_input_, input_history_, output_, h_hist_, err0_, recurrent native histories, native epochs, and ordinary gradient scratch at their defined logical lengths.
partition_population.external_predictor: Mixer, SSE, context tables, all q1 file-backed semantic state, frontend, and reversible-transform state that can affect a future coded probability or inverse byte.
partition_population.midpoint: Capture, gradient, replay, detached-control, phase, arm, canonical-clear state, and every retained update-observation accumulator.

arms: v4 materialized P without v5 source
v5 P compiled with observer disabled
v5 P compiled with observer enabled
requirements: Two clean builds are byte-identical within each compile configuration.
All three arms emit identical every-bit probabilities, payload, archive, modeled inverse, raw inverse, and terminal future-affecting state on the frozen fixture.
Observer-enabled encoder and decoder probability streams are identical.
Every partition mutation control passes and terminal incremental roots equal independent full recomputation.
Observer-disabled source contains no active output path and remains the separate release/resource candidate.

resource_contract.release_resource_authority: Only the observer-disabled build may establish prize memory/runtime eligibility.
resource_contract.merkle_storage_rule: Store each real leaf digest and every pair-or-lone ancestor exactly once. A tensor with N leaves has fewer than 2N stored 32-byte nodes; dirty marking uses one bit per real leaf. The build receipt must derive the exact aggregate allocation from the source-bound layout and reject before execution if all observer storage and scratch exceed 268,435,456 bytes.
resource_contract.full_range_policy: Initial and terminal state-root builds use bounded chunks. Dirty-leaf checkpoint refresh may page out only the exact fully hashed q1 mapping pages it touched; no complete 26-range scan or complete pageout occurs at a periodic checkpoint.

receipt_contract.schema_registry_policy: Validate both schemas directly while qm8 is live. A future registry revision may add them only after qm8 terminal dispatch and must rebind every then-active dependent contract rather than silently invalidating frozen evidence.
receipt_contract.direction_rule: Every run has independently parsed encoder and decoder streams.
receipt_contract.failure_rule: A missing stream, footer, record, partition, update, digest, parser result, inverse, guard, package member, or source-completeness row makes evidence_complete_pass=false and forbids a scientific gain verdict.

activation_requirements: The active q1-v3 qualification receipt and independent verification must pass under the current policy, and the canonical full-1G lease and lock must be absent.
V4 source must materialize under its exact existing source-only contract before v5 is derived without editing v4 in place.
A new source-difference manifest must prove that v5 changes only observability, schema, receipt, and build plumbing while P/K/F/S prediction arithmetic is byte-identical to v4.
An independent parser and source-completeness auditor must be content-addressed and must not import the emitter implementation.
Canonical registry integration is deferred until qm8 terminal dispatch; direct schema validation is mandatory in the meantime.
The frozen neutrality fixture and all six partition mutation controls must pass before any native finite-coder archive is interpreted.
No source build, fixture, coder arm, or corpus run is authorized by this design-only ABI.
claim_boundary: This artifact freezes serialization and proof topology; it does not implement an observer or prove that v4 or v5 compiles.
Merkle roots and update records provide collision-resistant audit evidence, not a compression gain or Hutter score.
No q1 qualification, P/K identity, encoder/decoder synchronization, archive improvement, inverse, package, memory, runtime, or dependency fact is inferred.
All v4/v5 midpoint evidence remains zero Gamma compression and objective score credit until fresh counted archives exist.
